recipe_version.title: British Kedgeree with Hot-Smoked Salmon, Jammy Eggs, and Peas
recipe_version.description: Basmati rice cooked with onion and curry powder, folded with flakes of hot-smoked salmon and peas, and topped with jammy halved eggs, parsley, and lemon wedges.

ingredients.name: mild curry powder
ingredients.display_name: mild curry powder whose label lists spices only

ingredients.name: hot-smoked salmon
ingredients.display_name: hot-smoked salmon whose label lists salmon, salt, sugar, and natural smoke

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Chop the onion and parsley, rinse the rice until the rinse runs clear, flake the salmon, and cut the lemon into wedges.

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.body: Heat the oil in the 3-quart saucepan over medium, about 1 minute. Cook the onion until soft, about 6 minutes, then stir in the curry powder and rice for 1 minute.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: Add 2 1/4 cups water and the salt, bring to a boil over high, about 4 minutes, then cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes. Scatter the peas over the rice, cover again, and rest off the heat 10 minutes.

steps.title: Boil the eggs
steps.body: While the rice cooks (overlap stated): bring 4 cups water to a boil in the 2-quart saucepan over high, about 6 minutes to come to a boil. Lower in the eggs and simmer 7 minutes, then cool under the cold tap for 2 minutes and peel.

steps.title: Fold and serve
steps.body: Fluff the rice and peas with a fork and gently fold in the salmon and most of the parsley. Pile onto plates, top with the halved eggs and the remaining parsley, and serve with lemon wedges.
